shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f \( -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.mjs" \) -print | head -50 && git diff package.json
cat next.config.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx tsconfig.json __agent_eval__/run.mjs; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'

grep -rl "proxy.ts\|PROXY_FILENAME\|proxy\.ts" node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.js node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js 2>/dev/null | head; grep -o "PROXY_FILENAME[^;]*;" node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.js | head -3; grep -rn "middleware.*deprecated\|proxy.*instead" node_modules/next/dist/build/utils.js | head -5
grep -rn "export.*proxy\|default export\|MiddlewareConfig" node_modules/next/dist/build/analysis/get-page-static-info.js | head -10; grep -rn "'proxy'" node_modules/next/dist/build/utils.js | head -5
git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md next-env.d.ts && git status --short
